scope: Real uses and real figures for the home projects in src/engine/content/homes.ts PROJECTS: home-theater, library, soundproofing, walk-in-closet, sauna (home-gym and dance-studio not researched here). Status: verified = read on the publisher's own page on 2026-10-04; secondhand = figure seen only in a search-engine summary or a third-party page, primary page blocked or not read; estimate = derived here, derivation given.

practice.claim: SAG-AFTRA Foundation members book its Virtual VO Lab 'for technical help with their home setup or to record auditions/practice sessions with our audio engineers'; virtual sessions require 'a quiet recording space'. Sessions are 50 minutes.
SAG-AFTRA Foundation audition-prep classes require participants to 'self-record, edit, label, save and submit voiceover auditions from home'.
practice.source: SAG-AFTRA, Voiceover Audition Prep: Home Submission
practice.note: sagaftra.org returned 403; wording from search summary

practice.claim: SAG-AFTRA guidance on building a home voiceover studio: the space must allow high-quality recording and timely submissions to employers.
practice.source: SAG-AFTRA, Create a Home Voiceover Studio Like a Pro

practice.claim: Backstage advises recording voice acting at home in the least noisy small enclosed space, such as a closet full of clothes, with fans and air conditioning off.
practice.source: Backstage, Voiceover Acting Tips: How to Record Voice Acting at Home

practice.claim: Studios sell audition recording as a service for actors without a home setup: Voice Trax West books VO auditions in half-hour slots with an engineer who edits and sends the file.
Most commercial scripts are about 30 seconds (also 10 or 5 seconds for social); time the take to about one second under the allowance.
practice.source: Spotlight, Getting Started in Commercial Voice Over

sessionMinutes.detail: Voice Trax West books a VO audition as one half hour total: 15-20 minutes recording plus 10-15 minutes editing and sending. SAG-AFTRA Foundation virtual lab sessions are 50 minutes.

heaters.note: dealer page via search summary, not Finnleo's own

typicalKW.derivation: A 2-4 person room is about 5-9 m3 (170-300 cu ft per the KIP60B listing); HUUM DROP 6 (6 kW) covers 5-9 m3 and Harvia/HUUM 4.5 kW units cover 3-6/3-7 m3.

preheat.detail: Harvia manuals: 'If the heater output is suitable for the sauna room, it will take about an hour for a properly insulated sauna to reach the required bathing temperature'; suitable bathing temperature about 65-80 C. The Harvia-built kit installation guide (Home Depot-hosted PDF, read directly) says 'Be sure to let the sauna heat for at least one hour before using the sauna' and its timer runs one hour and shuts off. HUUM DROP manual (via search, PDF now 404): about 10 C per 8 minutes, 80 C in about one hour.
preheat.status: verified for the one-hour kit guide line; secondhand for the Harvia manual quotation and HUUM rate (PDF text not extractable / 404)

session.source: Laukkanen T, Khan H, Zaccardi F, Laukkanen JA. Association Between Sauna Bathing and Fatal Cardiovascular and All-Cause Mortality Events. JAMA Intern Med 2015;175(4):542-548 (KIHD cohort, 2,315 Finnish men)
session.note: figures from search summaries of the paper and a hosted PDF copy; not read on jamanetwork directly, and this fullarticle URL was not opened

rounds.detail: Finnish practice: two or three hot-room rounds of about 10-15 minutes, each followed by a cool-down (shower, outdoors, plunge); the Finnish Sauna Society's own guidance says to take breaks, cool off and drink water, and leave if unwell, without stating minutes.
rounds.status: secondhand for round counts and minutes (Wikipedia / sauna retailers); Finnish Sauna Society page verified but gives no numbers

walkInCloset.status: verified (builder/remodeler guide; NKBA's own closet figures not found)

booksPerFoot.basis: compact-shelving vendors' planning average, volumes per linear foot
measured average across the Tri-College (Bryn Mawr, Haverford, Swarthmore) libraries, books and bound journals
average book width 0.99 in across disciplines = 12 books per linear foot packed solid

billy.shelves: 1 fixed + 4 adjustable shelves (6 book levels counting the base)

booksPerShelfEstimate.derivation: IKEA publishes no book count. Inner width about 2.5 ft (31.5 in outer less two side panels) x 8-9 volumes/ft (CLIR) = 20-23; x 6 levels = about 120-140 books per BILLY.

spareBedroomShelvingFeet.derivation: No published typical figure found. Four BILLY units (10.5 ft of wall) x 6 levels x ~2.5 ft = 60 ft; lining two 10-ft walls of a 10x10 bedroom = about 8 units = ~120 linear ft = ~960-1,080 books at 8-9/ft. Room size is an assumption, not a source.

homeTheater.mostCommon: Four seats ('one of the most popular home theater seating configurations in America')
homeTheater.status: verified (seating manufacturer guide; CEDIA's recommended practices are paywalled and not read)

spareBedroomSeats.derivation: A spare bedroom of 100-150 sq ft falls in Seatcraft's 2-4 seat band; four is the top of it and the stated most common layout.

filmRunningTime.source: Stephen Follows, 'Are two-hour movies the new normal?', 2 April 2026

cost.note: the game's $2,850 figure is from a different cost guide; Angi's own page returned 403

assemblies.wall: 2x4 stud, 5/8 in gypsum one layer each side, batt insulation
same plus resilient channel one side
assemblies.note: lab figure; 'actual results could be substantially lower' if installed carelessly

typicalProjectSTC.derivation: A retrofit spare-bedroom job at a $2-3k cost-guide price is insulation plus resilient channel and new drywall on existing studs, not a double-stud rebuild; stcratings.com puts that at STC 45-52, against 34-39 for an ordinary insulated wall. At 45-50 loud speech is not heard through it and a loud TV is; it suits voice recording and rehearsing lines, not drums.

soundproofing.whatItIsFor: A quiet room for recording self-taped and voice-over auditions (SAG-AFTRA Foundation asks for 'a quiet recording space') and for rehearsing without disturbing others.

notFound: Dublin: no studio-own page with a published hourly rate for a dedicated VO booth; The Podcast Studios and Egoboo say 'contact for pricing' (EUR 70 + VAT figure is search-summary only).

Vancouver: no cheap audition-booth rate on a studio's own page; only Monarch's CAD 250/h professional VO/ADR rate. Search summaries attributed Voice Trax West (actually Studio City, CA) and Voice One (San Francisco) to Vancouver/Toronto in error; both excluded.
New Haven: no studio inside New Haven proper with a published VO rate; nearest are West Haven (Horizon) and New Milford (Myke Foo).
sagaftra.org, backstage.com, angi.com, homeguide.com, manuals.plus and mayoclinicproceedings.org returned HTTP 403; those claims are marked secondhand.
Harvia and Finnleo PDF manuals: text not extractable (encoded fonts); HUUM DROP US manual PDF now 404.
Finnish Sauna Society publishes no minutes or round counts in its web guidance (its instructions are comic-strip PDFs, not read).
CEDIA recommended practice (seating counts) is behind membership; not read.
NKBA closet dimensions not found; builder guide used instead.
No published 'typical shelving length in a spare-bedroom library'; given as an estimate with derivation.
IKEA publishes no book count for BILLY; estimate derived from CLIR volumes per foot.
Home-gym and dance-studio projects were not part of this research brief.
